findings.game: range 65.8 m; steepest 11.7% / -9% over 50 m; the famous climb to T3: 11.6%/100 m
findings.real: BEV ALS DTM 1 m along the OSM centreline: range 63.8 m (676.9..740.7 m ASL), steepest 12.4% / -9% over 50 m, climb to T3 12.1%/100 m; de.wikipedia "maximale Steigung 12 % und maximale Gefälle 9,3 %", en.wikipedia 65 m, formula1.com 63.5 m; car heights 63.1 m. Game vs lidar: rms 2.37 m, max 5.3 m, grade over 100 m rms 1.85 pp, max 5.8 pp. Local GLO-90 errors (4-6 m humps, > 2 pp): s 3295-3460 (232 m after T8): game 8.4% vs 2.6%; s 3070-3240 (T8): game -3.7% vs 0.9%; s 1815-1940 (218 m before T4): game -8.4% vs -4%; s 2225-2340 (T5): game 4.7% vs 0.6%; s 3535-3635 (86 m before T9): game -5.7% vs -2.5%; s 2410-2510 (144 m before T6): game -1.5% vs 1.4%; s 1460-1540 (231 m after T3): game -2.4% vs -4.9%; s 95-150 (199 m before T1): game 1.3% vs 3.5%

findings.game: Schönberg straight (T3 -> T4) 5-7 m too high, then -8.5%/100 m at s 1880; +4.9% hump after T5 (s 2300); +8.5% hump before T9 (s 3350)
findings.real: lidar: Schönberg straight a steady -4..-5.7%; after T5 +1.6% at most; before T9 +4.3% at most; the climbs to T1 (+10.3%/100 m) and T3 (+12.1%/100 m) and the descent to T7 (-8.6%/100 m) match the game within 1.2 pp
sources: BEV ALS DTM 1 m (Austria, airborne laser scanning, release 2023-09-15, CC BY 4.0), COG https://data.bev.gv.at/download/ALS/DTM/20230915/ALS_DTM_CRS3035RES50000mN2650000E4650000.tif (range reads cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/bev-als-dtm-N2650000E4650000/)

findings.real: lidar DTM cross-fall: median 1.4 deg, p95 2.6, max 4.8 (T3 Remus); per corner (inside lower): T1 2.3 vs game 2.3; T2 1.4 vs game 0.8; T3 2.3 vs game 3.3; T4 2.6 vs game 4.6; T5 1.4 vs game 1.3; T6 1.9 vs game 3.2; T7 1.9 vs game 3.3; T8 1.3 vs game 1.5; T9 1.9 vs game 3; T10 2.7 vs game 2.9; no published bank angles (tools/build-tracks.mjs BANKED comment)
findings.proposedFix: bankOverrides where the game differs by >= 2 deg (proposedCorrections), or the measured cross-fall profile
